```artifact
Feature: Alarms for VTE and O2 Input Line

  Scenario: HIGH VTE alarm triggers when VTE exceeds threshold
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 500 mL
    When the VTE for the current breath is 550 mL
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm should be active

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm has medium priority
    Given the LOW VTE alarm is active
    Then the LOW VTE alarm priority should be medium

  Scenario: HIGH VTE alarm has medium priority
    Given the HIGH VTE alarm is active
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm priority should be medium

  Scenario: VTE is computed for each breath
    Given the system is monitoring breaths
    When a new breath is detected
    Then the VTE for the breath should be computed

  Scenario: Pressure high alarm does not re-trigger for 2 minutes after cancellation
    Given the pressure high alarm is active
    And the alarm is cancelled
    When 2 minutes have passed
    Then the pressure high alarm should not be active

  Scenario: High-priority alarm triggers when O2 input line is disconnected
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered

  Scenario Outline: Display all active alarms when multiple alarms are present
    Given the following alarms are active: <alarms>
    When the GUI displays active alarms
    Then the displayed alarms should be <alarms>

    Examples:
      | alarms                     |
      | LOW VTE, HIGH VTE          |
      | LOW VTE, Pressure High     |
      | HIGH VTE, O2 Disconnected  |

  Scenario: Event log includes all confirmed alarm settings
    Given the following alarms are confirmed: <alarms>
    When the event log is reviewed
    Then the event log should include <alarms>

    Examples:
      | alarms                     |
      | LOW VTE, HIGH VTE          |
      | LOW VTE, Pressure High     |
      | HIGH VTE, O2 Disconnected  |
```
